It is both the familiar launcher for your apps and a proactive, intent-driven agent: every app is a touchpoint, backed by one shared memory and an understanding that keeps evolving.
由 Makepad 的 Splash 演化而来、面向 Agent 需求优化的动态: A dynamic DSL evolved from Makepad's Splash and tuned for agents. It interprets app logic and generates UI in real time with no compile step: JavaScript-like on the surface, Rust underneath. App Cards and theme kits are built with it.
可嵌入的 Rust 原生 Agent harness 内核。多轮交互、上下文与记: An embeddable, Rust-native agent harness kernel. Multi-turn interaction, context and memory, model providers, concurrent agents, tools, sandboxing and user approval are all exposed to apps through the OS UI protocol.
OctoSense 是运行在操作系统之上的 Agent 交互 Shell。它看起: OctoSense is an agent shell on top of your operating system. It looks like the launcher and the apps you already know, and it behaves like an agent that understands your intent, senses what is changing around you, and reshapes those apps before you ask.
今天的 Agent 界面都是聊天框：线性、单向、只有文本。OctoSense 走: Today's agent interfaces are chat windows: linear, one-way, text only. OctoSense takes the other road. It keeps the app interactions people already know and puts the agent inside the apps, instead of pulling people into a chat box.
新闻、天气、行情、出行仍是稳定的起点，入口之下的内容围绕你的意图生成。: News, weather, markets and travel stay stable places to start. Beneath each one, the content is generated around your intent.
由时间和事件驱动：降温、航班延误、日程变化，都会让应用重新组织、提前准备。: Driven by time and events: a cold front, a delayed flight or a schedule change makes the apps reorganize and prepare ahead.
把为十亿人打造的超级应用裁剪到你需要的部分，持续生成、持续进化。: Super apps built for a billion people are trimmed to what you need, generated and evolved continuously.
重要决定留给你。Agent 把一天提炼成几件需要确认的事，确认后一切随之更新。: The important decisions stay with you. The agent distills the day into a few things to confirm, and everything updates once you do.

9 月 13 日开放报名与组队。可以单人参赛，也可以多人组队；队长和每位队员均须: Registration and team formation open September 13. Enter solo or as a team; the captain and every team member must register individually.
9 月 13 日起，通过本页动态二维码或腾讯问卷报名。参赛队伍须通过初赛、复赛，: From September 13, register through the animated QR code or Tencent Questionnaire on this page. Teams must advance through the preliminary and semifinal rounds to join the October 17 live final at GOSIM. Prize amounts will be announced.
2026 年 9 月 13 日开放报名组队，10 月 17 日在 GOSIM S: Registration and team formation open September 13, 2026. Finalist projects will be showcased at GOSIM Shenzhen 2026 on October 17. Enter solo or as a team; captains and every member register individually. Advance through both the preliminary and semifinal rounds to reach the final.
先阅读 hagency 仓库，选择一个具体工厂任务并设计应用。robrix2 小: Start with the hagency repository, choose a specific factory task and design an app. The robrix2 mini app integration is being planned. Runtime packages, capabilities, examples and submission rules for practice data will be explained before training; entrants do not need to copy the existing example UI.
单人可参赛；多人队伍的队长、队员均须分别填写。: Solo entries welcome. Team captains and all members must each complete the form.
单人或多人均可参赛。队长和每位队员分别报名，可边组队边开始初赛。: Enter solo or as a team. Captains and every member register individually; start your preliminary project while forming a team.
提交明确场景、可运行原型、源码与说明、短视频和截图；随作品提交已报名成员名单。: Submit a clear use case, working prototype, source and instructions, short video and screenshots, plus your roster of registered members.
独立评阅、运行核验与交叉复核。通过初赛后，进入复赛继续完善作品。: Independent reviews, runtime checks and cross-review. Teams that pass the preliminary round advance to improve their apps in the semifinal.
完善真实任务、数据与操作反馈，补齐失败状态、用户试用、测试证据及项目贡献。: Complete a real task, data and action feedback, failure states, user trials, test evidence and project contributions.
安装复现、任务验证与评分校准。通过复赛后获得决赛资格，10/11 18:00 前: Installation checks, task verification and score calibration. Advancing teams confirm their onsite representative by Oct 11, 18:00.
10/14 线上彩排 · 10/15 18:00 展示包冻结: Online rehearsal: Oct 14 · Demo freeze: Oct 15, 18:00
完善演示与稳定性，准备离线备用材料；10/16 进行现场设备联调，具体时段随会务: Improve the demo and stability, and prepare offline backups. Onsite equipment checks take place Oct 16 at times arranged with the conference.
10 月 17 日（周六）· 具体时段另行通知: Saturday, October 17 · Session time to be announced
晋级项目现场展示与答辩，评委合议及颁奖。3 分钟应用演示 + 2 分钟项目贡献，: Finalists demonstrate their projects and answer questions, followed by deliberation and awards. Each presentation includes a 3-minute app demo and 2 minutes on project contributions, plus time for questions.
完善 PR、应用和规范，按实际采纳结果核算采纳奖，归档优秀作品。: Polish PRs, apps and specifications. Adoption awards follow actual acceptance, and selected projects are archived.
了解两条赛道与晋级规则，梳理用户、场景、数据、操作和结果，参加组队交流。: Explore both tracks and advancement rules; define the user, scenario, data, action and outcome, and meet teammates.
从意图到脚本、校验、渲染与事件；完成一张有数据来源、正常与失败状态的卡片。: Go from intent to script, validation, rendering and events. Build a card with sourced data and both success and failure states.
学习脚本容器、能力、权限与版本，按 robrix2 UI 设计任务状态原型；实操: Learn script containers, capabilities, permissions and versions. Design a task-state prototype using robrix2 UI conventions; practical work uses the announced environment.
让队外用户完成一次任务，修正信息缺失和无反馈操作，整理原型、短视频与复现说明。: Ask someone outside the team to complete a task. Fix missing information and actions without feedback, then prepare the prototype, short video and reproduction steps.
认领贡献题，定义输入、权限、错误与版本；将最小能力或工具改进接回自己的应用。: Claim a contribution, define inputs, permissions, errors and versions, and connect a small capability or tooling improvement to your app.
消化初赛反馈，收敛复赛目标，补全数据与操作链路，列出正常、空值、拒绝和超时场景。: Use preliminary feedback to focus your semifinal goals. Complete the data and action flow, and list success, empty, denied and timeout scenarios.
分离生成、校验、渲染和评审，保留失败与重试；核对天气、空气质量等事实字段。: Separate generation, validation, rendering and evaluation. Keep failure and retry records, and verify facts such as weather and air quality.
验证任务变化、权限拒绝、过期与结果来源；区分练习数据和真实 hagency 接入: Verify task changes, permission denials, stale state and result provenance. Distinguish practice data from live hagency integration and retain reproducible evidence.
集中处理开发阻塞，整理共享 FAQ；假期不增加必修直播内容。: Resolve development blockers and maintain a shared FAQ. No new required live lessons during the holidays.
核对安装包、仓库版本、测试证据与视频，预留上传时间；当日 23:59 截止。: Check packages, repository revisions, test evidence and video, leaving time to upload. Submissions close at 23:59 that day.
组织 3 分钟实际操作与 2 分钟项目贡献，准备问题回答和离线备用演示。: Prepare 3 minutes of live app use and 2 minutes of contributions, plus answers to questions and an offline backup demo.
检查启动、投屏、计时与问答，列出冻结前修复项；每队具体时段随决赛名单公布。: Check startup, screen sharing, timing and questions. List fixes needed before the freeze; team slots are announced with the finalist list.
中秋与国庆假期以自主开发、课程回放为主，10/5 仅设可选答疑。10/16 现场: Use the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays for self-paced development and recordings; Oct 5 office hours are optional. Onsite equipment checks on Oct 16 use booked team slots, with times to follow.
赛道 B 开发包与接口准备中。实操环境、练习数据及提交接受范围在开课前统一说明。: Track B packages and interfaces are in preparation. Practical environments, practice data and accepted submission scope will be explained before training.
每一轮，都交付能验证的进展。: Deliver verifiable progress at every round.
初赛看需求与最小原型；复赛看完整任务、可用性与测试证据；决赛看现场演示和项目贡献: The preliminary round checks the need and minimum prototype; the semifinal checks complete tasks, usability and test evidence; the final checks live demos and contributions. Pass the preliminary and semifinal rounds in order to reach the final.
每轮按截止时的冻结版本评审。初赛侧重任务价值与可用性；复赛沿用四项评分，演示分依: Each round reviews the version frozen at its deadline. The preliminary round emphasizes task value and usability. Semifinal judging uses the four scoring categories, with demos assessed through video and reproduction; the final demo score comes from live performance. Advancement quotas and detailed rules will be announced.
可以单人或多人参赛。单人队伍由本人报名；多人队伍的队长和每位队员都须分别报名，队: Solo and team entries are welcome. Solo entrants register themselves; captains and every team member must each register. A captain cannot register on behalf of members. The proposed registration deadline is September 23 at 23:59, with the roster of registered members locked at preliminary submission on September 28.
9/13 开始报名 · 9/19 开营 · 拟定 9/23 23:59 截止（北: Registration opens Sep 13 · Kickoff Sep 19 · Proposed deadline: Sep 23, 23:59 (UTC+8)
核对报名名单、运行环境和材料，排查提交阻塞；初赛当日 23:59 截止。: Check registration rosters, environments and materials, and resolve submission blockers. The preliminary deadline is 23:59 that day.

报名、开营与决赛日期已确定；其余节点与具体时段为拟定安排。: Registration opening, kickoff and final dates are confirmed; other milestones and exact times are proposed.
9/19 开营后开始入门实践，9/29 分赛道进阶为复赛做准备。所有课程提供回放: Introductory workshops follow the September 19 kickoff. Advanced track sessions on September 29 prepare you for the semifinal. Recordings are provided; electives and clinics are optional.
9/29 的 A、B 进阶课使用两个教室同时开课，选择本赛道参加；面向所有初赛队: On September 29, advanced A and B sessions run simultaneously in separate rooms. All preliminary teams can attend their chosen track or catch up through recordings.
